title: bl_land.is_whole_suite lets --ff, --nf, --deselect, --ignore and --lf through as no whole-suite run although tests.run_scope calls them full and holds them to the seconds ceiling
goal: bl_land.is_whole_suite agrees with tests.run_scope: an option after which tests.py still runs in mode full (reordering or deselecting) counts as a whole-suite run, and the doc names only the options that select or skip nothing of the run's report

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import tests,bl_land;bad=[a for a in ("--deselect=x","--ff","--lf","--ignore=x","--nf") if tests.run_scope([a],False,False)=="full" and not bl_land.is_whole_suite(["python3","_tools/tests.py",a])];print(bad);sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
